sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु तान् सर्वान् राक्षसान् परिपार्श्वतः ।यूथपानपि तान् सर्वांस्ताडयामास रावणिः ।। ६.४६.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu tān sarvān rākṣasān paripārśvataḥ ।yūthapānapi tān sarvāṁstāḍayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ ।। 6.46.18 ।।।।

translations.english: The slayer of enemies, Indrajith attacked Neela with nine shafts, so also Mainda and Dwivida with three separate sharpedged shafts.
